summary: The sources dispatcher registers its recurring event without inspecting the wp_schedule_event() return value, so a scheduling failure is silent.
why_it_matters: wp_schedule_event() returns false (or a WP_Error via the pre-schedule filter) when registration is rejected. Ignoring it leaves the source dispatcher permanently unscheduled with no log entry to explain why sources stopped running.
suggested_fix: Capture the wp_schedule_event() result and log false/WP_Error outcomes through AIPS_Logger.
note: The raw time() half of the original finding no longer applies: line 107 already passes AIPS_DateTime::now()->timestamp().
